profile.headline: VMware Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Professional with a passion for software applications and cultivating relationships. I'm currently working for VMware as a Software Engineer that allows me to build, develop and ship customized software solutions to various clients and business partners. With my unique background in Computer Science and Sales, I can be the perfect fit for your Engineering department with a business, customer and engineering mindset . Feel free to contact me. Currently pursuing a Master Degree in Software Engineering part time at SJSU. 

Experienced Senior Sales Consultant with a customer and results driven focus with a demonstrated history in face to face sales, finance applications and customer service.  Strong work ethic with additional background in automotive sales, technical support, customer service and world-class hospitality in the DC area. Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science from University of Maryland College Park with a minor in Technology Entrepreneurship

In my free time, I'm an avid tennis player, board game enthusiast while always looking to spend my time outdoors. Looking forward to exploring the coast along Route 1 in California after the pandemic subsides. I never shy away from finding a new great place to eat.

Feel free to drop me a line or connect on social media.

positions.title: Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
- Created a scalable pipeline that will replace manual post processing of distributed test results for further performance analysis and continuous integration in production servers
- Developed a Kafka input layer for data streaming and used Faust for main async event processing in python including handling input, communication with backend service and storing data to MongoDB
- Exposed silo by rewiring backend on a Restful Flask API Microservice deployed in a Kubernetes cluster
- Collaborated with three teams and engaged in code reviews using Gitlab for CI/CD and testing with Pytest

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Educated new businesses on building up their web presence, ecommerce, social media and technical needs
- Designed, developed and maintained websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and MERN full stack
- Developed Business Model, Marketing strategy, and Pitch Deck for the first round of funding for Autoclarity. A startup focused on offering an anonymous, no haggle, transparent and reliable Car Buying Service designed to level the field for customers

positions.title: Senior Sales Consultant
positions.description:
Sold Vehicles while cultivating existing customer relationships and building rapport with new clients through unrivaled customer service and extensive industry and product knowledge
- Interacted face to face with multiple departments solving Carmax customer service challenges
- Received, structured and submitted thousands of auto loan applications with top financial institutions to get customers deals financed and funded.
- Garnered praise from peers and managers by outperforming sales goals and customer service metrics, consistently ranking at top of store for both, and training new hires at newly launched omnichannel.
- Attained Platinum level of President's Club selling 600+ units, consistently part of top 10% nationwide and above 20% conversion rate

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Developed Business Model, Marketing strategy, and Pitch Deck for the first round of funding for a startup focused on offering an anonymous, no haggle, transparent and reliable Car Buying Service designed to level the field for customers

positions.title: Project Leader
positions.description: Managed a group of 11 students creating an Expert System tool to be used in CMSC289. App enabled users with minimal knowledge of Artificial Intelligence to create expert systems using a web graphical interface with offline verification and testing. Created the front end while excelling in teamwork, communication and ensuring members delivered working prototypes on time

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: I served as a software engineer for Hughes Networks this past summer, where I helped my team research, conceive and develop software that tackle some of the challenges that they face in their fast-paced business. I expanded their data analysis tool to support queries over multi files and aggregation. Also, I wrote scripts using Linux, Apache and Python that retrieved massive amounts of records, and I presented the statistical results graphically by developing a web application.

positions.title: Professional Server and Bartender
positions.description: Premier Bartender and Server providing world-class Hospitality services to the highest Caterers and Hotels in the Washington, DC metropolitan area. Specialized in staffing, serving, bartending and managing events up to 500 guests.

positions.title: Business Owner
positions.description: Designed, developed and maintained websites for different small businesses implemented with HTML, CSS, JS and Ruby on Rails using MVC design pattern. Advised new businesses on building up their web presence and technical needs while also providing technical support

volunteerExperiences.companyName: University of Maryland - College of Computer, Mathematical, and Natural Sciences
volunteerExperiences.description: Mentor university students on academic, professional growth and technical interviews as part of the Alumni Mentorship initiative to better serve historically excluded students and first-generation college students in STEM

company.name: University of Maryland - College of Computer, Mathematical, and Natural Sciences
